name: How do I choose between an L-shaped, U-shaped, or galley kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between an L-shaped, U-shaped, or galley kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right layout depends on your room dimensions, traffic flow, and how you use the space for cooking and entertaining. An L-shaped layout with an island works well in open floor plans by keeping work stations clustered along two walls while maintaining connection to living areas. U-shaped kitchens maximize perimeter counter space and upper cabinet storage, making them ideal for dedicated home cooks in wider rooms. Galley layouts suit long, narrower footprints where maximizing every inch of counter and pantry storage takes precedence over casual island seating.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an L-shape for open entertaining and island additions, a U-shape for maximum storage and counter space, or a galley layout to optimize long, narrow spaces.
